summary: Jobs data is the dominant macro focus this week, with JOLTS out today and nonfarm payrolls due Thursday — both carrying direct implications for the Fed's policy stance. Meanwhile, the 10% global baseline tariff is set to expire July 24 with potential rate hikes to 15% thereafter, keeping trade policy risk alive and helping explain the tech-led equity greed signal against persistent gold and crypto fear.
tweet: Jobs week meets a tariff deadline: NFP Thursday and the 10% global tariff expiry looming July 24 are the twin pins stocks are threading right now.
